name: Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf
description: Ternary GGUF builds (PTQ1_0/PQ2_0) of a Qwen3.8-27B-derived reasoning model delivering ~1.72 bits/weight at ~6–7 GB, retaining 98.2% of FP16 intelligence with 262K context, runnable on a laptop or single GPU via a custom llama.cpp fork (CUDA/Metal/CPU).

name: succinct-router
description: Succinct Router is a 14M-parameter MLX decoder-only model that predicts calibrated pass probabilities for three candidate LLM configurations and selects the cheapest one expected to clear a quality threshold, achieving 95% exact-route accuracy and ~85% cost savings versus always using the largest model on synthetic evaluation data.

name: laya
description: Laya is an Apache-2.0 multilingual non-autoregressive decision model that answers typed questions (choices, scores, booleans) over text or JSON states with calibrated probabilities in a single ~33 ms forward pass, auto-routing across three checkpoints covering 100+ languages.

name: goldworm-v6
description: GoldWorm v6 provides a 2.76M-parameter byte-level PyTorch causal transformer checkpoint and config for TinyStories text generation, achieving verified full-validation BPC 1.007349 versus GPT-2 124M’s 1.142985 on the same metric.

name: gliformer-large-v1
description: GLiFormer Large v1 is a 575.6M-parameter layout-aware DeBERTa encoder that performs named entity recognition, text classification, joint relation extraction, nested structured extraction, and text embeddings using task labels and schemas provided at inference time.

name: open-jev-deberta-v3-large
description: A DeBERTa-v3-large encoder that maps one input state plus any number of typed questions (choice, ordered score, or yes/no) to calibrated per-question probability distributions in a single forward pass, reaching 0.854 in-domain accuracy at 0.022 ECE with zero structured-output errors.

name: Qwen3-14B-RLCD-Decision-LoRA
description: A QLoRA adapter for Qwen3-14B that specializes it for single-token parallel constrained decoding of multi-field JSON decisions in one broadcast forward pass, lifting reasoning-heavy field accuracy (fraud_risk 64%→95%, overall 85.2%→98.8%) at ~234ms per case.

name: openjev
description: openjev fine-tunes Qwen3.5 into a zero-shot NLI cross-encoder (4B text+image v2, plus a 35B-A3B MoE variant) that scores premise–hypothesis pairs as entailment/contradiction/neutral — one primitive for reranking, answer grading, content guarding, and driving real-time game agents like Doom and Minecraft.

name: cua-s1-forms
description: cua-s1-forms is a 706K-parameter single-pass option scorer that maps a GUI form element plus typed candidates (fill each extracted entity, check, click, skip) to per-option probabilities, letting cua-driver fill and submit forms without an autoregressive LLM.

name: Bespoke-MiniCheck-7B
description: A 7B fact-checking model finetuned from InternLM2.5-7B-Chat on 21K ANLI plus 14K Llama-3.1-405B–generated synthetic examples that scores whether a claim sentence is supported by a grounding document (up to 32K tokens), achieving SOTA on the LLM-AggreFact benchmark.

name: gliner2.5-multi-v1
description: GLiNER2.5-multi-v1 is a 287M-parameter multilingual mDeBERTa-v3-base checkpoint that unifies entity extraction, text classification, structured extraction, span-attribute scoring, and relation extraction in one boundary architecture with schema-constrained decoding.

name: decider-2b
description: decider-2b is a 1.9B-parameter model that returns calibrated probability distributions over explicit option lists for multiple typed questions in one forward pass—no text generation—for fast routing, classification, judgments, and agent decisions.

name: gliguard-LLMGuardrails-300M
description: gliguard-LLMGuardrails-300M is a compact 0.3B-parameter encoder guardrail model that scores prompt/response safety, toxicity, jailbreak attacks, and refusals in one schema-conditioned pass, matching guardrails 23–90x larger at up to 16x faster inference on CPU.

name: Qwen-2.5-1B-RLCD
description: An MLX Qwen2.5-1.5B model for Apple Silicon that evaluates JSON schema fields in parallel via KV-cache broadcasting and logit slicing, delivering 5.6–7x faster structured extraction and classification than autoregressive decoding with guaranteed-valid output and calibrated field confidences.

name: privacy-filter
description: A 1.5B-parameter (50M active) bidirectional token-classification model that detects and masks PII across 8 privacy span categories in a single forward pass, offering a 128K context window, tunable precision/recall operating points, and coherent BIOES span decoding for on-premises or browser-based data sanitization.

name: sales-conversion-model-reinf-learning
description: A Stable Baselines3 PPO reinforcement-learning model that predicts sales conversion probability turn-by-turn (96.7% accuracy, 85ms inference) from conversation embeddings and LLM-derived engagement/effectiveness metrics, enabling real-time sales coaching and quantitative A/B testing of scripts.

name: needle
description: Needle is a 26M-parameter pure-attention (no FFN) encoder-decoder model distilled from Gemini 3.1 for on-device function calling and tool use, reaching 6000 tok/s prefill and 1200 tok/s decode on the Cactus runtime, with open weights and local Mac/PC finetuning support.

name: Arch-Router-1.5B
description: Arch-Router-1.5B is a compact Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-based text-generation model that maps conversation intent to user-defined domain/action routes and outputs JSON route selections, enabling transparent, configurable, low-latency routing to preferred LLMs.

name: laya-grounded
description: A fine-tune of the laya typed-decision model that improves grounding on explicitly stated facts, consistency between logical inverses, and probability calibration, at the cost of worse phishing detection and option-name routing stability.

name: gliner2.5-cua-grounder-macos-v1
description: A merged FP32 GLiNER2.5 fine-tune that chooses an action ID, `reobserve`, or `abstain` from a bounded action menu for local macOS CUA automation—without screenshots or tool calls—and is verified on browser DOM and native AppKit fixtures with low-latency MPS inference.

name: potion-base-8M
description: potion-base-8M is an 8M-parameter static embedding model distilled from bge-base-en-v1.5 via Model2Vec and Tokenlearn, producing sentence embeddings orders of magnitude faster on CPU and GPU while retaining ~92% of all-MiniLM-L6-v2's average MTEB performance for resource-constrained or real-time applications.

name: laya-vision-smolvlm-256m
description: A SmolVLM-256M-based vision-language decision model that produces calibrated multiple-choice and yes/no probabilities for an image plus optional text in one non-generative forward pass, enabling fast confidence-aware visual question answering (~71 ms on an NVIDIA L4).

name: Jeff-1
description: Jeff-1 is an Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 that scores caller-supplied labels to return typed decisions—choice, yes/no, and ordinal scores with probabilities and confidence—for local inference tasks like fact-checking without parsing generated text.

name: Bespoke-Nimble-9B
description: Bespoke-Nimble-9B is a 165 MiB Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter for Qwen3.5-9B that scores allowed boolean, enum, and integer-rubric tokens for context-grounded structured predictions without free-form generation, with tokenizer, prompt builder, inference helper, and evaluation results.

name: jev-schema-scorer-deberta-v3-large
description: A fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-large encoder with a scalar head that scores (state, question + candidate) pairs, decoding grouped logits via softmax into choice, boolean (noul), and ordinal score answers—reading criteria and option ids at inference time so one checkpoint handles new label sets without retraining.

name: chessjev-minilm-v1
description: A chess option scorer that finetunes MiniLM-L6 with an attention head to emit logits for all legal moves from a FEN context in one forward pass, distilled from Stockfish 19 (0.445 teacher agreement, 0.667 on tactics) for fast move ranking rather than verified playing strength.

name: gliner2-privacy-filter-PII-multi
description: A 205M-parameter GLiNER2 fine-tune that detects and masks PII across 42 entity types in 7 languages, achieving the highest span-level F1 and recall on the SPY benchmark for redaction, compliance, and data-hygiene workflows.

name: rlcd-modernbert-151m
description: A 151M-parameter ModernBERT-based decision engine delivering calibrated choices, scores, and probabilities—plus an explicit abstention slot—in a single ~35ms non-autoregressive forward pass, deployable in-browser via WebGPU/WASM or via ONNX for edge inference.

name: gliner2.5-base-v1
description: GLiNER2.5 Base is a 194M-parameter English DeBERTa-v3-base checkpoint whose boundary architecture unifies schema-driven NER, classification, relation extraction, structured-record parsing, and span-attribute scoring, with constrained decoding and local CPU/CUDA/MPS inference.

name: gliclass-modern-base-v2.0-init
description: A 151M-parameter ModernBERT-based GLiClass model that performs efficient zero-shot multi-label text labeling in a single forward pass, supporting topic tagging, sentiment analysis, NLI-style premise–hypothesis scoring, and RAG reranking with cross-encoder-level accuracy at lower compute.

name: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Decision
description: A low-latency inference interface over Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (no new weights) that resolves BOOLEAN and CHOICE questions via candidate softmax over logits, returning picks with confidence, margin, and rankings via a prefix-cache-optimized vLLM /decision endpoint.
